title: Reliability and accuracy of varicocoele videos in YouTube
screen_reason: The abstract reports a quantitative share of items judged against an external ground truth: of 73 included varicocoele YouTube videos, 37 (50.7%) were classified unreliable/inaccurate relative to the European Association of Urology Sexual and Reproductive Guidelines 2020. Guideline concordance stated as reliable/unreliable is an accuracy judgement against an external standard, so this is a CONTENT prevalence share, not a bare quality score. The DISCERN/GQS/JAMA instruments are also used, but their results are reported only as significance tests (no means, no shares), so they yield no row.

estimates.measure_type: % of assessed varicocoele YouTube videos classified unreliable/inaccurate against EAU guidelines
estimates.denominator: 73 varicocoele-related YouTube videos included for assessment (of 151 videos screened)
estimates.definition: A video was counted in the numerator if it fell in the 'unreliable' group when videos were divided into two groups by reliability and accuracy using the European Association of Urology Sexual and Reproductive Guidelines 2020.
estimates.misinfo_def: No explicit definition of misinformation; falsity operationalised as non-concordance with guidelines: "The videos were divided into 2 groups according to their reliability and accuracy using the European Association of Urology Sexual and Reproductive Guidelines 2020."
estimates.source_quote: Of the 151 videos assessed, 73(48.34%) were included; 36(49.3%) reliable and 37(50.7%) unreliable.
estimates.ground_truth_detail: Researchers classified each video as reliable or unreliable against the European Association of Urology Sexual and Reproductive Guidelines 2020; modified 5-point DISCERN, Global Quality Score and JAMA scores were also computed. Number of raters and inter-rater reliability are not reported in the abstract.
estimates.moderator_quote: A cross-sectional study was conducted at Turkey in September 2020, and comprised YouTube videos related to varicocoele.
estimates.notes: Abstract only, so several moderators are coded from limited information. (a) Country: the only country stated is Turkey (study setting); the abstract does not say in which language YouTube was searched, so the video pool may not be Turkey-bounded. (b) The 151 -> 73 reduction is an eligibility screen of the search results; the abstract does not say whether the search was rank-truncated (top-N), so denom_selection is left empty rather than curated. (c) breadth coded 'misleading' because non-concordance with a clinical guideline can attach to content that is incomplete or overstated rather than outright false. (d) population_scope coded general_public (open platform content), though the abstract reports that 40 (54.8%) of videos were uploaded by medical advertisers/for-profit companies and 19 (26%) by universities or professional organisations.

missed_or_uncertain: Not extracted: (1) the reliable share, 36 (49.3%), which is the complement of the extracted row and carries no additional information; (2) DISCERN, Global Quality Score and JAMA results, reported only as 'All scores were significantly higher for reliable videos (p<0.05)' with no means or shares - a QUALITY construct with no extractable share; (3) mean views (108448+/-90567 reliable vs 392626+/-895897 unreliable) and like/dislike/comment rates - these are engagement contrasts between groups, not a share of exposure that was misinformation, so no EXPOSURE or REACH row is derivable (a view-weighted share of unreliable content would require a computation the abstract does not license); (4) uploader composition, 40 (54.8%) medical advertisements/for-profit and 19 (26%) universities/professional organisations - not a misinformation share.

rob.design: Cross-sectional content analysis of YouTube, Turkey, September 2020: 151 varicocoele-related videos assessed and 73 included; each video classified reliable vs unreliable against EAU Sexual and Reproductive Guidelines 2020 and scored with modified 5-point DISCERN, Global Quality Score and JAMA; engagement (views, comments, likes, dislikes) compared between groups; SPSS 23. Search strategy, keywords, language, sampling depth, number of coders and inter-rater reliability are not reported in the abstract.
rob.item6_quote: The videos were divided into 2 groups according to their reliability and accuracy using the European Association of Urology Sexual and Reproductive Guidelines 2020.
rob.item10_quote: Of the 151 videos assessed, 73(48.34%) were included; 36(49.3%) reliable and 37(50.7%) unreliable.
